sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act to January 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to construction and mentoring programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to construction and mentoring programs; provides that any agency may establish a mentoring program for small businesses that perform construction or architectural or engineering services related to construction.

sponsored.t: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded
sponsored.sum: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded; mandates that the contractor use such enterprise identified on the utilization plan, unless such enterprise cannot perform or is no longer state certified.

sponsored.t: Relation to the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to promulgate a written protocol for the regulation of the use of artificial intelligence and facial recognition technology in criminal investigations.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises where there is privity of contract between a small business enterprise and a subcontractor or contractor working on an authority public works contract.

sponsored.t: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces
sponsored.sum: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces; requires a report.

sponsored.t: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act to provide for policies, procedures and guidelines on suicide prevention, intervention and postvention for every higher education institution.

sponsored.t: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including MWBEs, to participate in state contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned business enterprises, to participate in state contracts.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on state agency utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires an annual report on state agency utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises detailing expenditure totals and percentages and whether agency MWBE participation goals were achieved.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks in certain cases
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks to ascertain the payment status of a student loan of an applicant for employment.

sponsored.t: Preserves the ability to appeal a violation of a defendant's right to make a statement personally at sentencing
sponsored.sum: Preserves the ability to appeal a violation of a defendant's right to make a statement personally at sentencing notwithstanding a defendant signed an otherwise valid waiver of appeal.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to calculate the period of rent reduction due to diminution of services from the date of actual diminution of the services.

sponsored.t: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan
sponsored.sum: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan.

sponsored.t: Requires a review of school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues
sponsored.sum: Requires a local transportation regulatory agency to review school safety plans for traffic and transportation issues prior to the issuance of a building permit for a new school facility or the expansion or renovation of an existing school facility.

sponsored.t: Provides guidelines, corrective actions, and transparency, and to reconfigure the composition of committees of professional conduct within the office of professional medical conduct
sponsored.sum: Provides guidelines, corrective actions, and transparency, and reconfigures the composition of committees of professional conduct within the office of professional medical conduct.

sponsored.t: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats
sponsored.sum: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats; establishes a fund for the stewardship of mercury thermostats; extends the effectiveness of the mercury thermostat collection act.

sponsored.t: Provides for the registration of professional nurse anesthetist
sponsored.sum: Relates to the certification of registered nurse anesthetists; provides that for such certification an applicant shall file an application, be licensed as a registered professional nurse, have satisfactorily completed educational preparation for the administration of anesthesia by an accredited entity and pay a fee; specifies who may represent themself as a registered nurse anesthetist.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain information to be included in the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring that the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development contain information on the annual minority and women-owned business enterprise utilization and expenditure categorized by minority-owned enterprises, women-owned enterprises, and total utilization and expenditure, and be organized by certain industry categories.

sponsored.t: Provides for the election of judges to the city-wide Courts of Civil and Criminal jurisdiction within the City of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the selection of judges to Family Court within the City of New York.

sponsored.t: Provides for the election of judges to the Family court within the City of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides for the election of judges to family court within the City of New York, rather than for the appointment of such judges.

sponsored.t: Establishes a public awareness campaign related to maternal depression; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public awareness campaign related to maternal depression; establishes the maternal depression fund; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Prohibits law enforcement officers from using bias-based profiling
sponsored.sum: Prohibits police officers from using bias-based profiling; requires that a procedure be established for the taking and review of complaints against police officers for bias-based profiling; allows an action for injunctive relief and/or damages to be brought against a law enforcement agency, any agent of a law enforcement agency and the supervisor of an agent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

sponsored.t: Ensures that parents and guardians of youth up to age 19 are notified when their child is arrested
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of arrest warrants upon a youth who is still in high school; provides for the police officer to make a reasonable effort to notify the parent or other person legally responsible for the care of such youth or with whom the youth is domiciled that the youth has been arrested; provides that the police officer need not notify the parent or other person legally responsible when such youth is not also a juvenile offender and the notification would endanger the health and safety of such youth; amends provisions relating to sexually exploited children to include persons under the age of nineteen.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for certain taxpayers who suffer the birth of a stillborn child
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for certain taxpayers who suffer the birth of a stillborn child.

sponsored.t: Allows taxpayers to contribute to the tuition assistance program on personal income tax forms
sponsored.sum: Allows taxpayers to contribute to the tuition assistance program fund on personal income tax forms; establishes the gifts to the tuition assistance program fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits medical assistance providers from refusing to furnish care, services or supplies to any person for whom Medicaid is secondary insurance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits medical assistance providers from refusing to furnish care, services or supplies to any person who is entitled to receive such care, services or supplies under this title if such medical assistance provider furnishes the same care, services or supplies under the Medicare program pursuant to title XVIII of the federal social security act and the person is dually eligible under that program.

sponsored.t: Requires all residential leases to disclose tenants' rights
sponsored.sum: Provides that all residential leases shall contain a detailed description of tenant's statutory rights including among others, warranty of habitability, willful violation of lease, right to participate in tenants' associations, no eviction for good faith complaint, utility payment offset and sublet rights; grants tenant the right to install extra locks; sets out landlord obligations with respect to heating and oil delivery.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination in government procurement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination in government procurement.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant; declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the standard for when a practice has a discriminatory effect
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the standard for intentional discrimination or retaliation claims by requiring a person or persons prove that an unlawful motivation was a motivating factor and not "the sole motivating factor" or a "but-for cause" of the challenged treatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the retail sale of flavored tobacco products and accessories
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retail sale of flavored tobacco products and accessories; imposes a fine of not more than five hundred dollars for each infraction.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rights, benefits and privileges that members of a retirement system who retire from such system and later rejoin such retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that members of a retirement system who retire from such system and later rejoin the retirement system are reinstated with the same rights, benefits and privileges they had prior to retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to written notice to unsuccessful minority- or women-owned business enterprise bidders on state contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires public corporations and agencies to provide written notice to each minority- or women-owned business enterprise that unsuccessfully bid on a contract of the reason or reasons why the business enterprise was unsuccessful in obtaining the contract.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission to study sexual misconduct in state correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and investigate sexual misconduct in state correctional facilities among incarcerated individuals and employees; devises a reporting system for notification of such misconduct to appropriate authorities; establishes duties and membership of such commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for prompt payment by contractors receiving public funds of amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors receiving public funds to pay amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises within 10 days of receipt of an undisputed invoice generated by a small business, minority-owned business enterprise or vendor management service and managed service provider on behalf of the small business or minority-owned business enterprise.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the New York state environmental facilities corporation from entering into contracts, leases or other agreements with entities that are not compliant with the MWBE requirements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the New York state environmental facilities corporation from entering into contracts, leases or other agreements with entities that are not compliant with the requirements of article five-A of the general municipal law regarding participation by minority- and women-owned businesses.

sponsored.t: Establishes "Jeremiah's Law"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Jeremiah's law"; establishes the offense of filing a false report concerning a minor.

sponsored.t: Relates to redefining science, technology, engineering and math education (STEM)
sponsored.sum: Relates to redefining science, technology, engineering and math education (STEM).

sponsored.t: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain one or more independent MWBE consultant firms to conduct an independent review of procurement procedures utilized by state agencies.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of public service to develop a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of public service to develop, implement, administer and operate a temporary middle income home energy assistance program; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides that any charges assessed by a credit card company for late payment shall not exceed five percent of the unpaid balance of any bill or twenty dollars
sponsored.sum: Provides that any charges assessed by a credit card company for late payment shall not exceed five percent of the unpaid balance of any bill, including any interest thereon, or twenty dollars, whichever amount is less.

sponsored.t: Requires that certain contracts let by the office of general services be reserved for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned businesses enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires that certain contracts let by the office of general services be reserved for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Creates a grant program for school districts, institutions of higher education, nonprofit organizations, other entities to prepare students for postsecondary STEM education and careers; appropriation
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Adjusts state qualitative skill education assessment standards; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Removes the board of trustees of the state university of New York as a charter entity; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the board of trustees of the state university of New York as a charter entity.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting on agency minority and women-owned business development contracts and spending
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting on agency minority and women-owned business development contracts and spending.

sponsored.t: Requires the board of directors of a cooperative apartment corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of directors of a residential cooperative housing corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request.

sponsored.t: Authorizes political subdivisions to award public contracts to participants of a MWBE program at a cost premium not to exceed ten percent of the lowest bid
sponsored.sum: Authorizes political subdivisions to award public contracts to participants of a minority and women owned business enterprise program at a cost premium not to exceed ten percent of the lowest bid.

sponsored.t: Requires managed care providers to annually provide each participant in their programs with a written list of mail-order pharmacies
sponsored.sum: Requires managed care providers to annually provide each participant in their programs with a written list of mail-order pharmacies with which the managed care provider has a contract for coverage of prescription drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the Beacon School Pilot Program in New York city schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the Beacon School Pilot Program in New York city schools.

sponsored.t: Enacts the reproductive health care facilities and religious worship access act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the reproductive health care facilities and religious worship access act; provides that the crime of criminal interference with health care services or religious worship shall be established by the mens rea of knowingly injuring, intimidating or interfering with a person obtaining or providing or assisting in obtaining or providing reproductive health services or a place of religious worship; includes in the definition of such crime engaging in a course of conduct or repeatedly committing acts within twenty-five feet of the premises of a reproductive health care facility or a place of religious worship; defines such premises; provides for a civil cause of action for any person harmed…

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Safe Staffing for Hospital Care Act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Safe Staffing for Hospital Care Act"; establishes minimum staffing levels for various health care workers in different health care facilities; requires submission of staffing plans; prohibits most mandatory overtime.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of employer for purposes of wage payment provisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of employer for purposes of wage payment provisions; includes municipal corporations, public benefit corporations and public authorities in the definition of "employer".

sponsored.t: Relates to payment by public owners to contractors and subcontractors
sponsored.sum: Relates to payment by public owners to contractors and subcontractors.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Michael K. Williams law" to establish a grant program to incentivize counties and municipalities to reduce prison populations
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Michael K. Williams law" to establish a grant program to incentivize counties and municipalities to reduce prison populations; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires the provision of additional insurance coverage for pre-term labor hospitalizations, monitoring and counseling
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for pre-term labor hospitalizations, home visits to monitor pre-term labor patients and counseling.

sponsored.t: Relates to unfair claim settlement practices
sponsored.sum: Provides that an insurer doing business in this state shall be liable to a policy holder for such insurer's refusal to pay or unreasonable delay of payment to the policy holder if such refusal or delay was not substantially justified; enumerates instances whereby an insurer's refusal or delay of payment is not substantially justified including intentional negligence, failure to act in good faith, failure to provide written denial of claim, failure to make final determination of claim within six months, and failure to promptly proceed with the appraisal process.

sponsored.t: Relates to state contracts being only with internet service providers compliant with net neutrality
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "NYS net neutrality protection act"; relates to state contracts being only with internet service providers compliant with net neutrality; prohibits the purchase of internet services from a non-net neutral source of internet services; requires certain disclosures by internet providers.

sponsored.t: Adjusts state qualitative skill education assessment standards
sponsored.sum: Adjusts state qualitative skill education assessment standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive exemption of new multiple dwellings from local taxation
sponsored.sum: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive exemption of new multiple dwellings from local taxation.

sponsored.t: Requires expunction of records resulting from identity theft or mistaken identity
sponsored.sum: Requires expunction of records resulting from identity theft or mistaken identity.

sponsored.t: Authorizes labor unions to work with the city of New York to finance the construction of affordable housing for its members
sponsored.sum: Authorizes labor unions to work with the city of New York to finance the construction of affordable housing for its members.

sponsored.t: Includes urban farming within farm operations for purposes of agricultural districts
sponsored.sum: Includes urban farming within farm operations for purposes of agricultural districts.

sponsored.t: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive grant or appropriation money
sponsored.sum: Relates to a minority and women-owned business enterprise participation goal requirement in order to receive grant or appropriation money.

sponsored.t: Establishes the state financial literacy fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the state financial literacy fund which provides funding for project grants to organizations in order to establish financial capability and financial literacy programs, products content and/or services for at-risk populations in New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to provision of interpreters at poll sites in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections in cities with a population of one million or more to provide at least one interpreter for all languages that are designated city-wide languages at poll sites that contain an election district with at least fifty voting age residents whose limited English proficiency language is a designated city-wide language.

sponsored.t: Establishes a career explorations class to integrate academic and vocational education, link secondary and post-secondary education and provide learning activities and mentoring at the work site
sponsored.sum: Establishes a career explorations class to integrate academic and vocational education, link secondary and post-secondary education and provide learning activities and mentoring at the work site; provides students with school-based learning and work-based learning.

sponsored.t: Authorizes broadband franchises in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Authorizes broadband franchises in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to the conduct of political party meetings, conventions and caucuses via video-conferencing
sponsored.sum: Permits the conduct of political party meetings, conventions and caucuses via video-conferencing; permits proxy voting.

sponsored.t: Authorizing the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law; requires contractors in violation of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law to retain independent monitors to oversee compliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring state and local law enforcement officers to identify themselves to the public during law enforcement activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an emergency repair program
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities to set up a program that repairs emergency violations of habitability for residents in twenty-four to forty-eight hours from notification; provides for the billing of the owners of the property for such repairs.

sponsored.t: Require boards of elections to provide Haitian Creole language voting materials
sponsored.sum: Requires boards of elections to provide Haitian Creole language voting materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enrollment of students at charter schools, the suspension of students at charter schools and the administration of charter schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment, organization, and administration of charter schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to criteria for certification by the division of minority and women's business development of MWBE status; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to criteria for certification by the division of minority and women's business development of MWBE status; replaces the personal net worth limitation with a requirement that a business have been awarded contracts by one or more agencies within the past three years where the total state funding received by the enterprise from the expense and capital budgets for such contracts was equal to or greater than sixty million dollars.

sponsored.t: Creates a revolving loan fund authority for the purpose of building renewable energy storage systems scaled to function as microgrids to power housing owned by the New York city housing authority
sponsored.sum: Creates a revolving loan fund through the New York state energy research and development authority for the purpose of building renewable energy storage systems scaled to function as microgrids to power housing owned by the New York city housing authority.

sponsored.t: Designates January 6th as Democracy Day
sponsored.sum: Designates January 6th as Democracy Day.

sponsored.t: Requires managed care providers that provide coverage for prescription drugs to provide coverage for home delivery of any covered prescription drug
sponsored.sum: Requires managed care providers that provide coverage for prescription drugs to provide coverage for home delivery of any covered prescription by any non-mail-order retail pharmacy in the managed care provider network.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation in state contracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements
sponsored.sum: Relates to increased participation in state contracts and subcontracts by certified minority and women-owned business enterprises; requires quarterly reports from contracting agencies; addresses consequences if contracting agency fails to comply with reporting requirements; relates to certain performance and payment bond requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to posting the names of individuals who are authorized to sign state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to posting the names of individuals who are authorized to sign state contracts; eliminates unfavorable terms in state contracts.

sponsored.t: Restructures the selection process for judges of the housing part of the civil court of the City of New York; repealer
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Restructures the selection process for judges of the housing part of the civil court of the city of New York; relates to designating petitions for candidates for the office of judge of the housing part of the civil court of the city of New York; makes conforming changes; abolishes the advisory council for the housing part of the civil court of the city of New York; repeals provisions relating to the selection and appointment of housing court judges.

sponsored.t: Prohibits charitable organizations from using charitable donations for confidentiality agreements or closed settlement agreements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a charitable organization from using any charitable donations that the charitable organization receives to make any sort of payment that arises as a term of a confidentiality agreement or closed settlement agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to childcare and dependent care reimbursement for volunteer members of public bodies
sponsored.sum: Provides for reimbursement of expenses for childcare and dependent care for volunteer members of public bodies.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a court from bifurcating certain primary elections
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a court from bifurcating the primary elections for members of the state and county committees and assembly district leaders and associate district leaders and all other party positions to be elected and all nominations for public office required to be made at a primary election in such year, except presidential primaries.

sponsored.t: Establishes protocols for the handling of stillbirths by healthcare facilities and establishing a stillbirth research database
sponsored.sum: Establishes protocols for stillbirths and a stillbirth research database.

sponsored.t: Modernizes the metropolitan transportation authority's small business mentoring program
sponsored.sum: Increases the threshold for office of the comptroller review of the metropolitan transportation authority discretionary awards to MWBEs and small businesses from one million dollars to one million five hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Expands insurance coverage for in vitro fertilization to include three complete oocyte retrievals and in vitro fertilization with unlimited embryo transfers; includes coverage under individual policies
sponsored.sum: Expands insurance coverage for in vitro fertilization; includes coverage under individual policies; provides coverage for three complete oocyte retrievals and in vitro fertilization with unlimited embryo transfers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes health insurers to provide actuarially appropriate reductions in health insurance premiums for participation in a wellness program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes health insurers and health maintenance organizations, subject to the approval of the superintendent of financial services, to provide actuarially appropriate reductions in health insurance premiums or other benefits or enhancements for an enrollee's or insured's participation in a qualified wellness program.

sponsored.t: Relates to collective bargaining agreement disclosure
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement agencies and political subdivisions to make publicly available any law enforcement collective bargaining agreement such agency or subdivision is subject to.

sponsored.t: Relates to legal representation in certain mortgage foreclosure actions
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for free legal representation in certain mortgage foreclosure actions where the homeowner is financially unable to obtain counsel; requires notice of such availability.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring town and village justices be admitted to practice law in the state
sponsored.sum: Requires town and village justices be admitted to practice law in New York state for at least five years as of the date they commence the duties of office.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the establishment, incorporation, construction, or increase in capacity of for-profit nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public health and health planning council and the commissioner of health from approving the establishment, incorporation, construction, or increase in capacity of for-profit nursing homes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state nurse employment, enhancement and dignity act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state nurse employment, enhancement and dignity act" to provide hazard pay to nurses during a state disaster emergency, an annual tax credit for nurses, a student loan forgiveness program for nurses, and preferential school admission for nurses.

sponsored.t: Requires pediatric care providers to screen every child beginning at the age of twelve months for autism spectrum disorders
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health and commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities to jointly promulgate rules and regulations requiring pediatric health care providers to screen children beginning at the age of 12 months for autism spectrum disorders during each wellness and preventative care examination and to conduct such screening annually until such child reaches age six, and thereafter at eleven and fourteen years of age.

sponsored.t: Requires signage on state highways designating where there are zero-emission charging and refueling stations nearby
sponsored.sum: Requires signage on state highways designating where there is a zero-emission charging and refueling station that is open and available to the public within three miles of an exit or off-ramp.

sponsored.t: Relates to the general hospital indigent care pool and funding for safety net and enhanced safety net hospitals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the general hospital indigent care pool and funding for safety net and enhanced safety net hospitals.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for explanatory statements regarding disposal of property
sponsored.sum: Requires explanatory statements regarding disposal of property to include the names of all beneficial owners.

sponsored.t: Requires recommendation of blood lead level screenings when a health care provider finds high lead levels in blood of a child
sponsored.sum: Requires the recommendation to a parent for blood lead level screenings of their child when a health care provider finds high lead levels in the blood of such child; directs the department of health to conduct an environmental investigation when a child is found to have high levels of lead in their blood.

sponsored.t: Makes certain not-for-profit corporations subject to the freedom of information and open meetings laws
sponsored.sum: Makes certain not-for-profit corporations subject to the freedom of information and open meetings laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a revolving fund for the establishment of municipal internet service providers; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a revolving fund for the establishment of municipal internet service providers; appropriates $250 million therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes duties for pharmacies when pharmacists employed by such pharmacy refuse to fill prescriptions on the basis of personal beliefs
sponsored.sum: Establishes duties for pharmacies when pharmacists employed by such pharmacy refuse to fill prescriptions on the basis of personal beliefs; requires a pharmacy to ensure the prescription is filled by another pharmacist; requires the pharmacy to inform individuals of items not in stock; requires such items to be ordered by another pharmacist without delay; sets forth penalty provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones, and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application
sponsored.sum: Requires mobile applications on cell phones, smart phones and tablets that offer a subscription service provide an option to cancel the subscription on its application and have the option posted in a clear and conspicuous format.

sponsored.t: Requires that thirty percent of state agency property management contracts be awarded to minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires that each agency letting contracts for the hiring of property managers for residential and commercial buildings structure procurement goals for such contracts that include the award of thirty percent of such contracts to minority and women-owned business enterprises; provides for the promulgation of rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing real estate value assurance insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing real estate value assurance insurance against loss of real estate value specifically attributable to local rezoning or significant changes in land use within their neighborhood that are not related to broader economic downturns.

sponsored.t: Provides for determinations of appropriate educational programs for certain students in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Relates to determinations of appropriate educational programs for certain students in a school district in a city having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Increases the state discretionary buying threshold without a formal competitive process for certain commodities from certain businesses
sponsored.sum: Increases the state discretionary buying threshold without a formal competitive process for certain commodities from certain businesses, including construction services.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for medical assistance for infants up to age three
sponsored.sum: Provides eligibility for medical assistance benefits for infants up to age three.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to include voter registration update forms in lease signature packages
sponsored.sum: Requires that every lease signature package provided to a tenant by a landlord or the landlord's agent shall include a New York State Voter Registration Form for each tenant over the age of eighteen years and information directing the tenant or tenants to the board of elections website.

sponsored.t: Relates to the study of the current prevalence of SNAP/EBT benefit fraud
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of social services to study and report on the prevalence and threat of SNAP/EBT benefit fraud.

sponsored.t: Establishes light duty during pregnancy and parental leave for railroad employees
sponsored.sum: Establishes light duty during pregnancy and parental leave for railroad employees.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of certain artificial intelligence models
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state agencies and state-owned entities from utilizing large language models or any artificial intelligence systems to make decisions that affect individuals' rights, benefits, or services; requires such decisions to be made by human personnel of the respective state agency or state-owned entity; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement.

sponsored.t: Extends to commercial tenants the right to seek a stay of the issuance of a warrant in a proceeding to recover the possession of premises in the city of New York
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Extends to commercial tenants the right to seek a stay of the issuance of a warrant and a stay of any execution to collect the costs of the proceeding in a proceeding to recover the possession of premises in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion
sponsored.sum: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person to include any member of the tenant's household lawfully occupying the premises as such person's residence who is 62 years of age with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion to provide protection to disabled and senior citizen non-purchasing residents of buildings that undergo cooperative or condominium conversions under an eviction plan even where such residents are not tenants of record in the buildings.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement of the state liquor authority to have not more than two members of the authority belong to the same political party
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement of the state liquor authority to have not more than two members of the authority belong to the same political party.

sponsored.t: Relates to first aid instruction for students in grades nine through twelve
sponsored.sum: Requires high schools to teach first aid instruction to students in grades nine through twelve.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on independent neighborhoods and homes in cities constructing micro-grids
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on independent neighborhoods and homes in cities constructing micro-grids to study the feasibility, efficiency, and energy saving costs if such micro-grids were constructed.

sponsored.t: Relates to preferences under the affordable home ownership development program for veterans with service-related disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to preferences under the affordable home ownership development program for veterans with service-related disabilities; defines "veteran with a service-related disability".

sponsored.t: Relates to contingency planning by state agencies for extended federal government shutdowns
sponsored.sum: Relates to contingency planning by state agencies for extended federal government shutdowns; requires the secretary to oversee development of shutdown contingency plans.

sponsored.t: Requires any hospital that provides birthing services to provide written, educational material containing information about premature, newborn infants
sponsored.sum: Requires any hospital that provides birthing services to provide written, educational material containing information about premature newborn infants.

sponsored.t: Relates to the fingerprinting of prospective child day care employees and sharing fingerprint results
sponsored.sum: Relates to the fingerprinting of prospective child day care employees and sharing fingerprint results.

sponsored.t: Relates to disposals and contracts for disposal of property
sponsored.sum: Provides for requirements for disposals and contracts for disposal of property.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Olivia Rae Salta, the daughter of Dawn Jimenez-Salta, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Olivia Rae Salta, the daughter of Dawn Jimenez-Salta, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system on behalf of her deceased mother.

sponsored.t: Authorizes nurses and doctors licensed in Puerto Rico to practice in New York State
sponsored.sum: Authorizes nurses and doctors licensed and in good standing in Puerto Rico to practice in New York State.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting law enforcement officers and peace officers from inquiring about the immigration status of a victim or witness to a criminal offense
sponsored.sum: Prohibits law enforcement officers and peace officers from inquiring about the immigration status of a victim of or witness to a criminal offense.

sponsored.t: Requires that Miranda rights statements be more specific
sponsored.sum: Requires that Miranda rights statements be more specific with respect to the right to counsel; requires inquiry into whether such rights are understood.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the tenants' bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Requires a notice informing tenants of their rights to be provided to tenants at the time they execute a residential lease and to be posted in certain buildings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises; defines special veteran emerging business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Expands the small business mentoring program
sponsored.sum: Expands the small business mentoring program to include contracts for construction or related services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits businesses and organizations from charging a fee for seminars, webinars, workshops, or educational resources related to the breakdown of Public Law No: 119-21
sponsored.sum: Prohibits businesses and organizations from charging a fee for seminars, webinars, workshops, or educational resources related to the breakdown or explanation of the contents of Public Law No: 119-21, colloquially known as the "One Big Beautiful Bill".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Clock Should Stop Act"
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of law examiners to establish protocols for addressing emergencies that occur during the administration of the bar examination, and to provide testing accommodations for persons who have applied for examination for admission to practice and are the subject of, or a witness to, or are affected by the emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to New York bar exam applicants
sponsored.sum: Allows an applicant with four or more unsuccessful attempts on the New York bar examination to file an application for re-examination for the February or July administration of the bar examination, provided such applicant successfully graduated from a law school located in and accredited by the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection of monies owed for unpaid real property tax liens and water and sewer charges; establishes the homeowner protection fund; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the collection of monies owed for unpaid real property tax liens and water and sewer charges; establishes the homeowner protection fund; prohibits municipalities from conveying tax liens on real property to any private entity, trust, or third-party servicer; repeals certain provisions relating to foreclosure of real property tax liens.

sponsored.t: Allows the city of New York to convey certain lands to the Amity Little League, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Allows the city of New York to convey the Amity Little League Baseball Complex to the Amity Little League, Inc. for a period of forty years; subjects the conveyance to the provisions of the Uniform Land Use Review Procedure.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development
sponsored.sum: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development; requires the number of new certifications and recertifications including the basis for any denials be included in the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 42 Chapter 661 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7222, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development" APPROVED The bill would amend the annual reporting requirements for the Divi- sion of Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprises (MWBEs) to require data around denials, length of time around for determinations on denials and more expanded information on contract expenditures. While I support the goals of the bill, and ensuring that data is available to evaluate the success of our small businesses and MWBEs, the data requirements set forth in the bill would impose substantial burdens on the Division of Minority and Women-owned Enterprise. I have worked with the legislature to address these issues by giving the Division more flexibility in…

sponsored.t: Establishes expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small and minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Establishes expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small and minority and women-owned business enterprises.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 105 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7235, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, the state finance law and the public authorities law, in relation to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small and minority and women-owned business enterprises" NOT APPROVED The bill would expand construction mentorship programs aimed at supporting small businesses and minority and women-owned business enter- prises (MWBEs). I support the goals of this bill, which are rooted in ensuring that the state can provide all small businesses with the skills and opportu- nities given to them to continue grow. The bill, however, would be cost- ly for agencies to implement and pose staffing and programmatic adminis- trative challenges. Many state agencies provide such mentorship opportunities…

sponsored.t: Establishes the interagency elder justice task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the interagency elder justice task force consisting of representatives of state agencies whose work involves elder justice to create greater collaboration and develop overarching strategies, systems, and programs with a goal of protecting older adults from abuse and mistreatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to scholarships for academic excellence
sponsored.sum: Provides that a scholarship for academic excellence that is declined by a student prior to the end of their high school program shall be granted to the next most qualified student, if practicable.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Eli Parker Levitt Law"
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance policies to provide coverage for transvaginal ultrasounds during pregnancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Requires school districts to provide information regarding water safety to parents or students upon enrollment
sponsored.sum: Requires school districts to provide information regarding water safety to parents or students upon enrollment.

sponsored.t: Relates to succession rights for tenants of New York city housing authority properties
sponsored.sum: Relates to succession rights for tenants of New York city housing authority properties.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the standard for when a practice has a discriminatory effect
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the standard for when a practice has a discriminatory effect; provides that an unlawful discriminatory practice may be established by such practice's discriminatory effect, even if such practice was not motivated by a discriminatory intent.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on Brooklyn College constructing a micro-grid
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority conduct a study on Brooklyn College constructing a micro-grid to study the feasibility, efficiency, and energy saving costs if such a micro-grid was constructed on campus.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health care providers to disclose the fact that the provider is on probation to current and new patients
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health care providers to disclose the fact that the provider is on probation to current and new patients.
